Notes on support vector machines, building up from the simplest linearly
separable case toward the soft margin, kernels, and multi-class extensions.

## Topics in this module

- **[Hard-Margin Linear SVM](hard-margin-linear/index.qmd)** — deriving the
  max-margin classifier by hand: the weights form (solved with quadratic
  programming) and the support-vector form (via the Lagrangian dual and KKT).
- *Soft-margin SVM (non-separable data, slack variables)* — planned.
- *Kernels for non-linear decision boundaries* — planned.
- *Multi-class SVM (one-vs-rest, one-vs-one)* — planned.
